# Upstream

- Project: earshot, https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot
- Version: 0.4.0 (tag `v0.4.0`, commit `591fa3e`)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`), Copyright (c) 2026 Leon Lin

Included unchanged: `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `skills/` (the `earshot` and `real-sound` agent skills) and the docs the
skills link to (`docs/SFX.md`, `docs/INTEGRATION.md`, `docs/launch-video-sound.md`, `docs/LIMITS.md`,
`docs/CREDITS_FIT.md`). The earshot Python package itself is not vendored: install it from the tag above (see
`modules/editing/skills/sound-effects/SKILL.md`). Links in these files to other upstream paths point at the upstream
repository. Update by copying the same files from a newer tag; never edit them here.
